topic: How one Oman retail company cut payroll prep from three days to two hours after switching to WPS-integrated payroll
format: Tight case study: company profile, problem, what changed, the one number that proves it worked
post:
Three days of payroll work. Every single month. For 60 employees.

Not because the team was slow. They were manually cross-checking timesheets, calculating deductions, formatting bank transfer files, then chasing approvals over WhatsApp before anything could move. One wrong cell in a spreadsheet meant starting the whole thing over.

They switched to SmartPRO Hub. WPS payroll with direct bank integration, automated deduction logic, one-click submission.

Payroll prep dropped from three days to two hours.

Same team. Same 60 employees. No spreadsheets in the middle.

SmartPRO Hub isn't a workaround bolted onto generic HR software. It's built specifically for local bank submission requirements and Ministry of Labour compliance — that's the starting point, not an afterthought.

The ops director's words after their first cycle: "We didn't realise how much time we were just losing."

If your payroll still runs on a shared Excel file and a lot of manual checking, that's a fixable problem.
